summary: The audit checks 27 units of Math graduate courses numbered 200-297, each letter graded with a B or better, and MATH 355 (Graduate Teaching Seminar). Checked by hand: further Math or approved courses, qualifying exams in two of the four areas, the area exam, advancement to candidacy, the oral exam and the dissertation. Teaching is not a degree requirement.

xD1CN7VI.why: "27 units of Math graduate courses numbered between 200 and 297." "Completion of the 1-unit course MATH 355: Graduate Teaching Seminar in the second year of the program." "Additional units should be Math department courses or approved courses from other departments." "Students are required to pass qualifying exams in two of four areas" "The student must complete their Area Exam by the end of Winter quarter of the third year." No unit count is given for the additional units, so that item is marked by hand. Grading: "The required 27 units of Math graduate courses numbered between 200 and 297 must be taken for a Letter grade." GPA: "A grade of B or better is required in courses that satisfy the 27 unit requirement."
